subject: Quick Hosted API eval — availability & sandbox handoff
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reeves <samantha@papertrail.ai>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick Hosted API eval — availability & sandbox handoff

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for signing up to try Redwood Hosted API — welcome! I saw your self-serve account get created and wanted to offer a short 30-minute technical walkthrough so we can:
- Confirm the integration pattern you expect to use (direct REST calls vs. SDK)
- Preload a small sample dataset into a sandbox so you can try inference quickly
- Walk through token/latency expectations and costs for your expected throughput

Are you available next week for a 30-minute slot? My earliest options: Wed 11/10 10:00–10:30 PT, Thu 11/11 09:00–09:30 PT, Fri 11/12 14:00–14:30 PT. If none work, send me two windows that do.

I’m looping in Dylan (cc) to coordinate the sandbox provision once we lock a time. I’ve attached a short quickstart PDF that highlights the REST flow and sample cURL snippets.

Thanks — looking forward to connecting.

Jonas Weber
SDR, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: hostedapi-quickstart.pdf (1 page)
From: Samantha Reeves <samantha@papertrail.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 16:04:32 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick Hosted API eval — availability & sandbox handoff

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the quick follow-up.

We’d love a technical walkthrough to make sure we can get a POC running quickly. Our preferred attendees: myself (integrations), Miguel (backend engineer). We are available Thu 11/11 09:00–09:30 PT or Fri 11/12 afternoon (anytime after 13:00 PT).

Two quick notes about scope:
- We'll test a low-latency inference path for document summarization (avg request 600 tokens)
- We’ll likely use Python server-side; Miguel will want the sample SDK calls

If you can lock Thu 11/11 09:00 PT, that works best. Please send a calendar invite and let us know if you need anything from our side before the call.

Best,
Samantha Reeves
Head of Integrations, PaperTrail.ai
samantha@papertrail.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reeves <samantha@papertrail.ai>
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 17:30:15 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick Hosted API eval — availability & sandbox handoff

Sounds good — booked Thu 11/11 09:00–09:30 PT. Invite attached (redwood-30min-invite.ics).

Diego — can you provision a 72-hour sandbox for PaperTrail.ai tied to the onboarding account (samantha@papertrail.ai) and preload a short example for document summarization (600 token inputs)? We’ll need a Python sample environment and a temporary API key scoped for the sandbox. Please confirm estimated readiness time — ideally before Thu 09:00 PT.

Samantha/Miguel — agenda for the 30 minutes:
1) Quick intro & success criteria (3 min)
2) Walk through the Python SDK and a live 2–3 request demo (12 min)
3) Discuss latency/cost expectations and batching recommendations (8 min)
4) Next steps and sandbox handoff (7 min)

If anything shifts, ping me and we can reschedule.

Thanks,
Jonas

Attachment: redwood-30min-invite.ics
